references.text: The same materials (blue, purple, and scarlet wool, and fine twisted linen) are used for the curtain at the entrance to the tent, with the same embroidered work.
The context of the dimensions and layout of the courtyard, of which the gate with its curtain is a part.
Description of the craftsmen who were given wisdom to carry out embroidery work using blue, purple, and scarlet wool and fine linen.
Fulfillment of the instructions—the curtain for the courtyard gate was made with the same materials, measurements (20 cubits), and four posts with four bases.
Parallel description of how the curtain at the entrance to the tent was made using the same materials and embroidery technique.
The responsibility of the Gershonites to carry the hangings of the courtyard and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard.
The making of the curtain confirms adherence to God's specific instructions.
